author: ChaosLensX
name: ChaosLensX
text:
He saved a $90 million jet from a runaway catering truck and got fired for it the exact same day. 🤦‍♂️

When an unmanned catering cart lost control and began spinning wildly toward the nose of a parked plane, other employees stood by, unable to help. Knowing disaster was seconds away, this ramp worker jumped into a tow tractor and deliberately rammed the cart, flipping it over and saving the aircraft.

Instead of a reward, his employer handed him a dismissal notice. The corporate reasoning? He didn't wait for approval, destroyed airport equipment without authorization, and violated safety regulations.
